title: Debrecen, the 'Calvinist Rome' and Market Towns
grammar: Directional and alignment postposition: mentén ('along / in alignment with')
goal: I can describe the civic culture, autonomy, and historical role of Alföld market towns like Debrecen.
I can use mentén both literally (along rivers/roads) and figuratively (in alignment with principles).
I can analyze the interplay between religious tradition, trade, and municipal self-governance.
